#SciFeature 𝗪𝗛𝗔𝗧 𝗔𝗥𝗘 𝗧𝗛𝗘 𝗛𝗜𝗚𝗛𝗘𝗦𝗧-𝗣𝗔𝗬𝗜𝗡𝗚 𝗦𝗧𝗘𝗠 𝗝𝗢𝗕𝗦 𝗜𝗡 𝗧𝗛𝗘 𝗣𝗛𝗜𝗟𝗜𝗣𝗣𝗜𝗡𝗘𝗦 𝗧𝗢𝗗𝗔𝗬? 

According to the latest Occupational Wages Survey released by the Philippine Statistics Authority, careers in air transport, engineering, and programming/media stand out as the country’s top earners as of 2024.

Leading the list are aircraft pilots and related associate professionals in the air transport industry, with an average monthly wage of ₱137,999. Close behind are air traffic safety electronics technicians, earning around ₱131,536 per month. Chemical engineers working in the manufacture of coke and refined petroleum products rank third, with an average of ₱101,996.

Rounding out the top five are mathematicians and actuaries, alongside applications programmers, both in the insurance, reinsurance, and pension funding sector, earning approximately ₱99,154 and ₱96,360, respectively.

These figures highlight how highly specialized STEM skills—particularly in aviation, energy, and data-driven industries—continue to command premium salaries in the Philippine workforce. #LaborDay
